name: FilterUsers
maximal_sql:
-- @filter-tree! (v0.3): the caller composes a closed predicate
-- vocabulary with And/Or; nil is rejected, FilterUsersUnscoped() is
-- the explicit opt-out. See PROJECT_INSTRUCTION Use Case 5.
SELECT u.id, u.email
FROM users AS u
WHERE TRUE
  AND ((u.tenant_id = $1) AND (u.status = $2) AND (u.email LIKE $3 || '%'))
ORDER BY u.id
LIMIT $4;
